## 4. lore — the crow and the open mouth

**ANNA:** the crow and the open mouth

**ANNA:** வாய்
> Take the simple word for mouth.

**ANNA:** On paper it is just anatomy, but at home it carries attitude.

**ANNA:** If someone talks back, elders will say the mouth is running too much.

**ANNA:** And if you sit at the table spacing out, there is an ancient warning waiting.

**ANNA:** வாய் திறந்தா காக்கா கொத்திட்டு போயிடும்
> Someone will glance across the room and casually say it.

**ANNA:** Literally, if you keep your mouth open, a crow will peck it and fly away.

**ANNA:** There are no crows inside. It is just family shorthand for snap out of it.
